issue.title: test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed fails on master: the agent_chat_from_name split moved six marker-path sites out of the reviewed allowlist
issue.description:
`tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_path_passing_audit.py::test_tracked_marker_path_passing_sites_are_reviewed`
fails deterministically on clean master. The audit compares every live
marker-path-passing call site against the hand-maintained
`_REVIEWED_PATH_PASSING_CONTEXTS` allowlist. Commit 7318c52b7
(`refactor(scripts): split agent chat resolver modules`, agent
`bbugyi200.athena.toobig-41.agent_chat_from_name.0`) broke
`src/sase/scripts/agent_chat_from_name.py` into
`_agent_chat_from_name_{common,failure,family,resume}.py` submodules. The six
call sites moved with it, so their `file:function` keys changed and the
allowlist no longer names them:

```
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_common.py:completed_response_path
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_common.py:resolve_done_response_path
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_common.py:resolve_meta_chat_path
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_failure.py:_resolve_failed_agent_transcript
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_family.py:_resolve_agent_family_member_shell
+ src/sase/scripts/_agent_chat_from_name_resume.py:_resolve_family_member_resume_transcript
```

There are no stale entries in the other direction: `reviewed - live` is empty,
so this is purely six renamed keys that need re-review and re-listing (the same
sites were already reviewed under their pre-split names).

## Remediation

Re-review the six moved sites and update `_REVIEWED_PATH_PASSING_CONTEXTS` to
their post-split `file:function` keys. Behavior did not change; only the module
each function lives in did.

## Discovery

Found by `sase-sq.8.1.land` while running the full test suite to verify epic
sase-sq.8.1 ("Retire the config glossary"). NOT caused by that epic: the epic's
three commits (cebab38a1, 93d379e0a, 882ba36f5) touch glossary/memory/ACE code
and never `src/sase/scripts/`, and 7318c52b7 landed at 2026-08-24 21:46, before
the epic bead was created at 23:10.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic, not intermittent: the assertion compares a statically scanned set of live call sites against a hardcoded allowlist, with no clock, network, concurrency, or ordering input. Reproduced identically in the full parallel lane and in an isolated single-node rerun on the same tree (master 882ba36f5), and the six extra keys are exactly the functions that commit 7318c52b7 moved into the new _agent_chat_from_name_* submodules.

Full-suite 'just test-cost' failed this node, and an isolated single-node rerun reproduced the identical six extra keys (_agent_chat_from_name_common.py:resolve_done_response_path, :resolve_meta_chat_path, _agent_chat_from_name_failure.py:_resolve_failed_agent_transcript, _agent_chat_from_name_family.py:_resolve_agent_family_member_shell, _agent_chat_from_name_resume.py:_resolve_family_member_resume_transcript, and _agent_chat_from_name_cli/common pair) with 'reviewed - live' still empty. Confirms the report survives commit 39bc4bc70, which moved more of the same CLI into _agent_chat_from_name_cli.py without touching the allowlist. Unrelated to my landing diff, which touches only memory-web templates, ACE config-hub tab-strip thresholds, and their tests.

Independently reproduced in the 36,803-test full lane at HEAD 2d908ca1145b while verifying unrelated beads-sidecar clone reliability changes. The node reported exactly the same six post-split _agent_chat_from_name_* marker-path contexts and is unrelated to the local SDD clone/audit diff.
